question: Does Zoloft have a boxed warning?

route.reason: Asking whether Zoloft (sertraline) has a boxed warning is answered by the FDA drug label.

draft.text: Yes. Zoloft (sertraline) carries a boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behaviors [label:sertraline:boxed_warning:0]. Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients in short-term studies [label:sertraline:boxed_warning:0]. The label says to closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening and for emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors [label:sertraline:boxed_warning:0].
